title: God Is Working in You
story:
A young girl wanted to learn how to play the piano.

At first, she struggled to play even the simplest songs.

Some days she felt excited to practice, while on other days she wanted to give up.

Her teacher reminded her, "The desire to learn is already part of the journey. Keep practicing, and you will grow."

Day by day, her fingers became more familiar with the keys.

She began to enjoy practicing and discovered that the desire she had to improve helped her keep going.

God works in a much deeper way in our lives.

He works within us, shaping our desires and giving us the willingness and strength to do what pleases Him.

Sometimes we may wonder why certain desires are growing in our hearts or why we feel drawn toward something that honors God.

We can remember that God is actively working within us.

We are not walking through life alone.

His Spirit is working in our hearts, guiding our desires and helping us live according to His good purpose.
life_lesson: God is actively working within you. He gives you both the desire and the strength to live according to His good purpose.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for working in my life.

Thank You for giving me the desires and strength to do what pleases You.

Help me to recognize Your work in my heart and to surrender my desires to Your will.

Guide my thoughts, decisions, and actions so that my life reflects Your good purpose.

Help me trust that You are working even when I cannot see everything You are doing.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What desire has God placed in your heart that may be leading you closer to His purpose?

Are there areas where you need to surrender your desires to God?

How can you cooperate with God's work in your life today?
verse: I am at work in your life through the desires of your heart.
